friction_section.title: The Friction Point
friction_section.subtitle: Barbershops manage walk-ins, appointment requests, repeat clients, missed calls, cancellations, and manual follow-ups that can reduce daily revenue.

cards.title: Manual Booking Overload
cards.description: Haircuts, beard trims, fades, shaves, grooming packages, and regular appointments often require constant phone calls and manual scheduling.

cards.title: Scattered Client Records
cards.description: Client preferences, appointment history, barber availability, service notes, and follow-up reminders are often managed across separate tools.

cards.title: Lost Repeat Bookings
cards.description: Without automated rebooking reminders, barbershops miss recurring revenue from regular trims, beard maintenance, fades, and grooming appointments.
